title: RaffleHouse
tagline: A free, public, and permissionless on chain raffle and giveaway platform.
description: RaffleHouse is a public and permissionless on chain raffle and giveaway platform. It is intended to be free (except gas) for everyone to be able to create a raffle now, or in the future. The idea came about after seeing so many scams on twitter of fake giveaways. There was also a need for legitimate raffles to be on chain for transparency and proof of fairness reasons.
how_its_made: Used mainly erc721 and chainlink apis for the smart contract itself. erc721 transfer and approval functions to move the nft around. chainlink vrf to select a raffle winner. It is deployed on polygon now, but in reality it needs to be deployed on every chain where a users whats to raffle an asset.
